title: Change Log
text: Version 1.0.0 PoPS Core C++ library interfaces: rpops R package r.pops.spread GRASS GIS module. release rpops includes: Susceptible-infected (SI) susceptible-exposed-infected (SEI) host phases (model_type, latency_period). Host mortality tracking (mortality_rate, mortality). Host removal pesticide application treatments (treatments, treatment_date, pesticide_duration). Host resistance based pesticide application treatments (pesticide_duration > 0). Treatments applied ratio hosts (treatment_application). Yearly pest removal based lethal temperature (lethal_temperature, lethal_month). Two different dispersal kernels (natural_dispersal_kernel, anthropogenic_dispersal_kernel). Cauchy exponential radial dispersal kernels use Von Mises distribution. Seasonal spread (seasonality months). Multiple stochastic runs (pops_multirun). Parallel execution multiple runs (number_of_cores pops_multirun). Output average standard deviation infected hosts across multiple runs single stochastic run (simulation_mean, single_run, simulation_sd). Average standard deviations output averages (number_infecteds, infected_areas). Infection probability output percent (probability). Spread rate measurement 4 cardinal directions (west_rate, east_rate, south_rate, north_rate ). Distance quarantine 4 cardinal directions (north_distance_to_quarantine, south_distance_to_quarantine, east_distance_to_quarantine, west_distance_to_quarantine ). Probability quarantine escape (escape_probability).

title: Pest or Pathogen Spread Model
text: PoPS package R built top PoPS Core C++ library includes: Susceptible-infected (SI) susceptible-exposed-infected (SEI) model types (model_type, latency_period). Host mortality tracking (mortality_rate, mortality_time_lag, mortality). Host removal pesticide application treatments (treatments, treatment_date, pesticide_duration). Host resistance based pesticide application treatments (pesticide_duration > 0). Treatments applied ratio hosts (treatment_application). Yearly pest removal based lethal temperature (lethal_temperature, lethal_month). Two different dispersal kernels (natural_dispersal_kernel, anthropogenic_dispersal_kernel). Cauchy, Exponential, Uniform, Power-law, Deterministic neighbor, Hyperbolic-Secant, Gamma, Weibull, Normal, Logistic radial dispersal kernels use Von Mises distribution. Seasonal spread (seasonality months). Host movement animals moving farm farm plants via nursery trade (use_movements, movements_file). Reduced stochasticity options (generate_stochasticity, establishment_stochasticity, movement_stochasticity) deterministic versions kernels (deterministic) required parameters reducing stochasticity (dispersal_percentage, establishment_probability). Spread rate measurement 4 cardinal directions (west_rate, east_rate, south_rate, north_rate) (use_spreadrates) true. Distance quarantine 4 cardinal directions (north_distance_to_quarantine, south_distance_to_quarantine, east_distance_to_quarantine, west_distance_to_quarantine) (use_quarantine) true (quarantine_areas_file) provided. Probability quarantine escape (escape_probability). Overpopulation function (individuals areas high population leave area disperse longer distances average) (use_overpopulation, overpopulation_percentage, leaving_percentage, leaving_scale_coefficient). Flexible output frequency n number days, weeks, months, years options (output_frequency, output_frequency_n).
